title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Monday
summary: Key points include progress in U.S.-Iran talks potentially leading to stock market gains, S&P 500's narrow avoidance of correction territory, mixed signals in Nike's earnings report, and various analyst upgrades and downgrades across different companies.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a mix of neutral to slightly negative news, with some positive developments in earnings and analyst ratings, but also includes concerns over litigation, market corrections, and competition.
